cases.situation: I'm organising a surprise 40th for my friend Claire and just found out the restaurant we booked for 18 people cancelled on us, 9 days before. Need to tell the group chat.
cases.reply: Bad news, everyone: Osteria Rosa cancelled our booking for the 17th this morning, they've had a flood in the kitchen. I know a few of you booked trains around it. The date stays the same; I've got holds at two other places near the station and I'll confirm one by Sunday. Still very much on.
cases.note: News in the first line, one line of why, acknowledge the cost to them, then what happens next.

cases.situation: 我是部门经理，公司今年冻结调薪，我得告诉组里的小陈，她之前一直在等这次涨薪，我也答应过帮她争取。打算先发消息约她聊。
cases.reply: 小陈，有件事想直接跟你说，不太是好消息。今年公司冻结调薪，你的涨薪这次没有批下来。我知道你一直在等，我之前也跟你说过会争取，这个结果我很抱歉。明天上午10点我们当面聊一下，我想跟你一起定一个明年上半年的具体目标，到时候我拿着它再去提。
cases.note: 消息放在前两句，不用模糊的'可能有点难'。当面聊比文字好，所以消息里先说清楚，再约时间。

cases.situation: Freelance dev. I found out the payment integration I promised a client for their Nov 1 launch can't be done with their current payment provider. Need to email the client, Rachel.
cases.reply:
Hi Rachel,
I'll get straight to it: Apple Pay can't be added on your current Paymark plan, so it won't be in the 1 November launch. I checked with their support this morning and it's only available on their enterprise tier. I know that was one of the features you wanted for the holiday rush. Two options: launch on the 1st with cards and PayPal, or I can set up Stripe alongside Paymark, which adds about a week. Happy to talk it through on a call tomorrow if that's easier.
Sam
cases.note: No three paragraphs before the news. If she's upset, don't defend; restate the two options and let her choose.
